cold_email.subject: made a free video ad for PeakForm Coaching 🎬
cold_email.body:
Hi Jordan,

I'll keep this short. I make scroll-stopping short-form video ads for fitness businesses in Denver, and I put together a FREE sample for PeakForm Coaching:

  [your sample video link]

No catch - I'd rather show you than pitch you. The goal of these is simple: lose fat and build a routine that lasts without you having to film anything.

If you like it, I can deliver 5 short-form video ads for $300 this week. Worth a quick look?

Best,
Sam
[your portfolio link]

outreach.sms: Hi Jordan, it's Sam. I made PeakForm Coaching a free sample video ad - [your sample video link]. Like it? I can do 5 short-form video ads for $300. Want more concepts?
outreach.walk_in_pitch:
"Hi, are you the owner? I'm Sam - I make short video ads for fitness businesses here in Denver. I actually already made one for PeakForm Coaching to show you - mind if I show you 15 seconds on my phone?"
[show sample] "If you like it, I can make you 5 short-form video ads for $300. Want me to put a pack together?"
outreach.upwork_proposal:
Hi Jordan,

You need 5 short-form video ads that actually convert - that's exactly what I do. I produce UGC-style AI video ads fast (24-48h turnaround) so you can test creatives without expensive shoots.

Here's a sample so you can judge the quality up front: [your sample video link]
Portfolio: [your portfolio link]

I can start today. Happy to do a first batch so you can see the results before scaling. When can we hop on a quick call? [your booking link]

- Sam

follow_up_sequence.message: Hey Jordan, did the sample video come through? Happy to tweak it to match PeakForm Coaching's vibe - just say the word.
No worries if now's not the time! Quick idea: I can send 2 more ad concepts for PeakForm Coaching so you've got options to test. Want them?
Last one from me 🙂 I'll hold a spot this week to make PeakForm Coaching 5 short-form video ads for $300. Want me to grab it for you before it's gone?

objection_handlers.too expensive: Totally fair - that's why I keep the first pack small. One ad that lands pays for the whole batch. Want to start with 3 for less?
objection_handlers.we do it in-house: Love that! I just speed things up - I can hand you ready-to-post videos so your team skips the editing. Want a free one to test?
objection_handlers.not sure it works: That's the point of the free sample - post it, watch the views, then decide. Zero risk to you.
objection_handlers.no time: You don't need any - you don't film or edit anything. I deliver finished videos ready to upload. Want me to just handle it?
objection_handlers.send info: Sent! Short version: 5 short-form video ads for $300, 48h turnaround, free sample first: [your sample video link]

outreach.tip: Personalize the first line per business and ALWAYS attach a real sample. Sample-first outreach converts far better than a pitch.

weekly_500_path.note: Close ~2 starter pack(s)/week at $300 to clear $500/week.

monthly_10k_paths.why: Recurring revenue compounds; less re-selling each month.
Faster to start, but you resell from zero every month.
Stable base from retainers, topped up with one-off packs.

thirty_day_plan.focus: Make 3-5 sample ads + set up a simple portfolio/link.
Send 25 sample-first outreaches/day. Close first 2-3 starter packs (~$500-900).
Deliver fast, collect testimonials, pitch Growth Retainer to happy clients.
Convert 2-3 clients to retainers. Keep 25 outreaches/day.
Stack retainers toward $10k MRR; raise prices as your portfolio grows.

pricing_and_revenue.disclaimer: Figures are planning aids based on your inputs, not income guarantees. Actual results depend on outreach volume, niche, offer quality, and delivery.
